  1159→  1159→      <h2 class="sec-title rev" data-i18n="digital_title">We Teach the Tools of <span style="color:var(--green)">Tomorrow.</span></h2>
  1160→  1160→      <p class="sec-body rev" data-i18n="digital_body">Star FM doesn't just broadcast — we educate. Dedicated programming, workshops, and on-air demonstrations bring AI awareness and digital skills to every listener in Klerksdorp and the Southern District.</p>

  1213→  1213→<!-- COMMUNITY -->
  1214→  1214→<section id="community">
  1215→  1215→  <div class="sec-label rev" data-i18n="community_label">The Mission</div>
  1216→  1216→  <h2 class="sec-title rev" data-i18n="community_title">Built For The Community.</h2>
  1217→  1217→  <p class="sec-body rev" data-i18n="community_body">Star FM 102.9 is not a corporate station. We are owned by, built for, and powered by the community of Klerksdorp and the Southern District. Every broadcast is an act of empowerment.</p>
